champion.tips: AATROX TIPS AND TRICKS Try and play around with your Passive and trade when it’s up. Don’t look for an extended fight unless your Passive is up; otherwise, you’ll miss out on extra damage. You can use your E to reposition your Q sweet spots. This includes using your E forwards, backwards and even left or right. Play safe at level 1, and then look to play aggressive from levels 2 to 6. Aatrox is an early game dominant champion, so make sure you play aggressive early on.
champion.builds: THE BEST AATROX BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR TOP IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Aatrox Top build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Bone Plating and Revitalize in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Spear of Shojin as your first item, followed by Plated Steelcaps and Voltaic Cyclosword. For your last 3 items, you should build Serylda's Grudge, Sterak's Gage and finish with Death's Dance. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 54.5% winrate over 10 895 matches played. Optional Your second option for Aatrox Top build would be to take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Eclipse, which you should build first, followed by Plated Steelcaps as your second item and Sundered Sky as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Spear of Shojin, Death's Dance and Sterak's Gage. The skill order for this build is Q - E - W. In the current patch, this build has a 51.1% win rate over 9 135 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Sundered Sky as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Spear of Shojin as a third item. You want to finish the build with Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance and Serylda's Grudge. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 52.7% win rate across 7 974 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Aatrox Top build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Grasp of the Undying, Demolish, Bone Plating and Overgrowth as your primary rune tree, and Magical Footwear with Biscuit Delivery as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Sundered Sky as your first item, then finish Plated Steelcaps as your second item, and Spear of Shojin as third item. The last 3 options are Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance and Guardian Angel. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 51.8% win rate over 695 matches played. Situational Aatrox Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Aatrox build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Aatrox runes page.
